content.text: In regions where conventional payment platforms like Stripe are inaccessible, digital creators face a significant hurdle: establishing an efficient online store capable of handling crypto transactions. Whether you're in Nigeria or Ethiopia, lacking reliable infrastructure inhibits your growth. This guide focuses on leveraging [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/supabase-order-database-digital-stores-step-step-deployment-13|supabase]] as your order database for digital stores, providing a no-nonsense approach to set up a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-18|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]]-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-19|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce solution without relying on restrictive platforms. By utilizing COREMERCH's frameworks, you can build an efficient store that processes payments seamlessly and serves your digital products instantly.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The fundamental issue with platforms like Stripe or PayPal is their unavailability in many countries, effectively excluding creators from the global commerce ecosystem. COREMERCH's architecture circumvents this limitation by providing sovereign tools for payment processing and order management. Using GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification, you establish a direct relationship with your customers. Supabase serves as your order database, ensuring you maintain full control over your data and transactions. This infrastructure is built to withstand the challenges of currency collapse and payment rejections, empowering you to operate independently.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, ensure you have a GitHub account for hosting your website and an active NOWPayments account to facilitate crypto transactions. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will be crucial for backend logic. Gather your digital products, whether they are ebooks, courses, or templates, and prepare them for upload. Lastly, set up your Supabase account for order management. This step is essential, as it will allow you to track sales, manage customers, and analyze product performance efficiently. With everything in place, you are ready to start building your infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying Stack 01, which integrates GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments. This process typically takes 4-6 hours if you follow the Sovereign Blueprint. Start by configuring your GitHub Pages site, creating an index.html file that showcases your products. Then, set up Google Apps Script to handle payment notifications and deliver your products seamlessly upon payment confirmation. The integration with NOWPayments ensures that transactions occur smoothly with minimal fees. Test your pipeline thoroughly to ensure that once a payment is made, your customers receive their digital goods instantly and reliably.
Full control over your store means you own your data and customer relationships.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up and tested, it’s time to go live. Announce your store through your social media channels and direct traffic to your GitHub Pages site. Monitor the initial transactions closely to ensure everything runs smoothly. Use Supabase to track orders and customer interactions, allowing you to adjust your product offerings based on real-time data. Your first transaction will set the tone for your operations, so ensure that the process is seamless from payment to product delivery. After a successful launch, you’ll have established a reliable income stream without depending on traditional payment platforms.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your infrastructure is live and operational, consider scaling your offerings. Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, allows for additional features and capabilities. In 48 hours, you can deploy an advanced version that includes more products and enhanced security layers like SPF/DKIM/DMARC. Analyze your sales data from Supabase to determine which products are performing well, then expand your inventory based on demand. Engage with your customers to gather feedback and improve their experience. As your sales grow, ensure to maintain the quality and reliability that set you apart in the digital marketplace.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, leverage GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing. This combination allows you to create a fully operational store without reliance on traditional payment platforms, ensuring your independence in the digital marketplace.
Deploy in hours, not weeks, and start selling your digital products immediately.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to enhance your store's capabilities, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which can be deployed in just 48 hours. This stack integrates Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, creating a robust architecture for digital commerce. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Utilize GitHub Pages for hosting your site, Google Apps Script for backend functionality, and NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing. This combination allows you to create a fully functional store without incurring traditional platform fees.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours for deployment, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, deployed in 48 hours with added security features and support.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are suitable for hosting digital product stores. They provide reliable infrastructure and can easily integrate with backend services for dynamic functionality.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments allows for acceptance of over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low transaction fee of 0.5%. It operates without KYC requirements or buyer accounts, ensuring a seamless payment experience.
How can I ensure my store is secure?
Implement security measures such as SPF, DKIM, and DMARC, especially if you are using Stack 02. Regularly monitor transactions and customer data to maintain the integrity of your digital store.
Ensure instant delivery of your products with automated payment confirmation.
